title: Assessing Robustness to Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Deep Reinforcement Learning for Cyber-Physical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.32496v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As the use of reinforcement learning (RL) becomes more widespread in cyber-physical systems, it becomes increasingly important to design RL agents that are able to adapt to changes in their environments in order to maintain safety and reliability. This paper addresses the question of whether different classes of RL algorithm are more robust against forgetting previously learned behaviours, a critical issue in continual learning, in non-stationary environments. We evaluate the robustness of representative examples of three important classes of RL algorithm in a non-stationary autonomous parking environment. These are Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), which is a model-free on-policy algorithm, Soft-Actor-Critic (SAC), which is a model-free off-policy algorithm, and Drama, which is a model-based algorithm. translated_title: 评估信息物理系统中持续深度强化学习对灾难性遗忘的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 随着强化学习（RL）在信息物理系统中的应用日益广泛，设计能够适应环境变化以保持安全性和可靠性的RL智能体变得越来越重要。本文研究了在非平稳环境中，不同类别的RL算法是否对遗忘先前习得行为（持续学习中的关键问题）具有更强的鲁棒性。我们在一个非平稳的自主泊车环境中评估了三类重要RL算法中代表性方法的鲁棒性，分别是近端策略优化（PPO）——一种无模型同策略算法、软演员-评论家（SAC）——一种无模型异策略算法，以及Drama——一种基于模型的算法。智能体必须学习在四种不同场景中成功泊车，这些场景依次呈现，泊车位朝向……
tldr: 该论文在非平稳自主泊车环境中系统评估了三类强化学习算法（无模型同策略的PPO、无模型异策略的SAC和基于模型的Drama）抵抗灾难性遗忘的鲁棒性，以确定哪类算法更适合信息物理系统中的持续学习。
en_tdlr: This paper assesses the robustness of three classes of reinforcement learning algorithms—model-free on-policy PPO, model-free off-policy SAC, and model-based Drama—against catastrophic forgetting in a non-stationary autonomous parking environment, to determine which class is best suited for continual learning in cyber-physical systems.
